name: colSums2
title: Calculates the sum for each column in a matrix

origin.description: Calculates the sum for each column in a matrix.
origin.usage:
colSums2(x, rows = NULL, cols = NULL, na.rm = FALSE, dim. = dim(x),
  ..., useNames = TRUE)

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: An NxK matrix or, if dim. is specified, an N * K vector.

arguments.name: rows
arguments.text: A vector indicating a subset of rows to operate over. If NULL, no subsetting is done.

arguments.name: cols
arguments.text: A vector indicating a subset of columns to operate over. If NULL, no subsetting is done.

arguments.name: na.rm
arguments.text: If TRUE, missing values are excluded.

arguments.name: dim.
arguments.text: An integer vector of length two specifying the dimension of x, also when x is not a matrix.

arguments.name: useNames
arguments.text: If TRUE (default), names attributes of the result are set, otherwise not.

origin.details: The implementation of colSums2() is optimized for both speed and memory. It calls the same routine as rowSums2() with byrow FALSE, so elements are still visited in column-major order.
origin.value: A numeric vector of length K, one sum for each selected column.

translation.description: Calculates the sum for each column in a matrix.
translation.usage: colSums2(x, rows=None, cols=None, na_rm=False, dim=None, use_names=True)

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: An N by K array, or a one-dimensional vector when dim is given. A two-dimensional array is read with axis 0 as rows and axis 1 as columns, matching the printed R matrix.

arguments.name: rows
arguments.text: 1-based rows to include. None uses every row. Zeros are dropped and negative values exclude, as in R.

arguments.name: cols
arguments.text: 1-based columns to include. None uses every column.

arguments.name: na_rm
arguments.text: If True, missing values are excluded. This is na.rm. A missing double is NaN. An all-missing column sums to 0 when na_rm is True and to NaN otherwise.

arguments.name: dim
arguments.text: Two integers giving the shape of x, also when x is not a matrix. This is dim. When x is one-dimensional, the values fill that shape in column-major order.

arguments.name: use_names
arguments.text: Accepted for compatibility with useNames. The result is always a plain float64 vector; names are not attached.

translation.details: The sums come from the rowsums2 crate, ported from matrixStats src/rowSums2.c with hasNA TRUE and byrow FALSE. Columns are accumulated from top to bottom. An empty column selection returns a zero-length vector. An empty row selection returns a zero for each column.
translation.value: A float64 vector of length K, one sum for each selected column.
translation.example:
import numpy as np
from matrixstats.rowsums2 import colSums2

x = np.array([[1, 3, 5], [2, 4, 6]], dtype=float)
colSums2(x)
